raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

sgl-project/sglang#45407 made `forward_low_ratio_sources` cut `x` and `q_lora` to the hoisted rows on every step (`x[:n]`, `q_lora[:n]`); before, it cut them only when DP attention padded an eager extend. On ROCm, `q_lora` (and on some routes `x`) reaches it quantized, as an `Mxfp8Activation` (q and scale) or an `Fp8GridActivation`: structs that refuse a slice. Since #45407, a DeepSeek-V4.1 server on MI35x fails while capturing its decode graphs (seen with `--monokernel-backend amd`; the failing call is SGLang's own forward, which every decode step of a plain server runs):

```
File ".../layers/attention/deepseek_v4_backend.py", line 3402, in forward_low_ratio_sources
    q_lora = q_lora[:n]
TypeError: 'Mxfp8Activation' object is not subscriptable
```

## Modifications

- `forward_low_ratio_sources` cuts `x`, `positions` and `q_lora` only when DP padding left rows past the hoisted ones, as before #45407. Decode and verify steps, where every row is live, pass them on uncut.
- That cut goes through `_first_rows`, which cuts a quantized struct field by field (`msgspec.structs.replace`) and a tensor with `[:n]`. On CUDA both are tensors here, so CUDA takes the same cut as on main.

## Accuracy Tests

MI350X, TP4, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, this branch on main 74c08f3dc5, with sgl-project/sgl-amd-mono main 52dceb0:

- `test/registered/unit/layers/test_dsv41_late_layer_tail_readers.py`: 13 passed. The new case (DP padding cuts a quantized `q_lora` field by field) fails on main with the error above.
- `test/registered/kernels/ops/attention/dsv4/test_dsv41_decode_glue_hip.py`: 6 passed.
- sgl-amd-mono's `test/e2e/test_deepseek_v41_server.py` (`--monokernel-backend amd`): 9 passed. GSM8K: 0.930 (DSpark verify server), 0.905 (decode server). Both servers step past the monokernels' widths onto this path.
- SGLang alone, without the monokernels, the same two servers, GSM8K (200 questions, 8 shots): 0.895 (DSpark verify), 0.905 (decode).
- sgl-amd-mono's `test/kernels/test_deepseek_v41_kernels.py` against this SGLang (K1, K2 and the FFN launch bit for bit, with and without aiter's preshuffle, every width the spec builds): 6 passed, on 048555d92f.

The other GPU runs used e62ad22f6a. The commits after it change only docstrings and the unit test.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

No speed change intended: decode and verify steps now skip a cut that kept every row. AgentX (InferenceX agentic coding, TP4, concurrency 1, 900 s) with the monokernels, on this PR's first version (048555d92f, same decode and verify path): P90 637.6 tok/s/user, P50 668.0, 6627 tok/s/GPU, acceptance length 3.52.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-and-profile).

@@ -326,6 +326,16 @@ def _prefill_graph_full_topk(layer, x, q_lora, pos):
 _bcg_low_ratio_source_projections = eager_on_graph(True)(_low_ratio_source_projections)
 
 
+def _first_rows(act, n: int):
+    """First ``n`` rows of ``act``, cut field by field for HIP's quantized activations
+    (``Mxfp8Activation``, ``Fp8GridActivation``), which refuse a slice."""
+    if isinstance(act, msgspec.Struct):
+        return msgspec.structs.replace(
+            act, **{k: getattr(act, k)[:n] for k in act.__struct_fields__}
+        )
+    return act[:n]
+
+
 def _as_int_list(values) -> Optional[List[int]]:
     if values is None:
         return None
@@ -3393,9 +3403,10 @@ def forward_low_ratio_sources(
             # extend past them; an eager break in the late-layer tail sees fewer, and
             # there extend_seq_lens still spans the whole extend.
             n = min(hoisted_pos.shape[0], positions.shape[0])
-            x, positions = x[:n], positions[:n]
-            if q_lora is not None:
-                q_lora = q_lora[:n]
+            if n < positions.shape[0]:
+                x, positions = _first_rows(x, n), positions[:n]
+                if q_lora is not None:
+                    q_lora = _first_rows(q_lora, n)
             req, pos = hoisted_req[:n], hoisted_pos[:n]
         if (
             forward_batch.forward_mode.is_extend()

@@ -10,6 +10,7 @@
 from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.dsv4.attn_metadata_kernels import (
     late_layer_tail_layout,
 )
+from sglang.kernels.ops.quantization.mxfp8_amd_gfx95 import Mxfp8Activation
 from sglang.srt.layers.attention import deepseek_v4_backend
 from sglang.srt.layers.attention.deepseek_v4_backend import (
     SWA_WINDOW,
@@ -323,7 +324,7 @@ class TestDSV4LateLayerTailLowRatioRows(CustomTestCase):
     """An eager low-ratio break inside the prefill graph's late-layer tail must read
     the hoisted rows of the tail, not rows rebuilt from the whole extend."""
 
-    def _run(self, hoisted_req, hoisted_pos, positions):
+    def _run(self, hoisted_req, hoisted_pos, positions, q_lora=None):
         backend = object.__new__(deepseek_v4_backend.DeepseekV4AttnBackend)
         backend.tail_source_kv_layer_id = None
         backend.forward_metadata = SimpleNamespace(
@@ -350,12 +351,13 @@ def _run(self, hoisted_req, hoisted_pos, positions):
             backend.forward_low_ratio_sources(
                 layer=layer,
                 x=torch.zeros(positions.shape[0], 4),
-                q_lora=torch.zeros(positions.shape[0], 4),
+                q_lora=torch.zeros(positions.shape[0], 4) if q_lora is None else q_lora,
                 positions=positions,
                 forward_batch=forward_batch,
             )
         compress_args = backend._low_ratio_compress.call_args.args
         index_args = backend._low_ratio_index_topk.call_args.args
+        self.index_q_lora = index_args[2]
         return compress_args[2], compress_args[3], index_args[3], index_args[4]
 
     def test_tail_break_uses_live_prefix_of_hoisted_rows(self):
@@ -369,6 +371,17 @@ def test_tail_break_uses_live_prefix_of_hoisted_rows(self):
         self.assertEqual(index_req.tolist(), [7, 7, 9, 9, 9])
         self.assertEqual(index_pos.tolist(), [2, 3, 3, 4, 5])
 
+    def test_dp_padding_cuts_a_quantized_q_lora_by_rows(self):
+        """HIP's quantized q_lora raises a TypeError on a plain slice; DP padding past the
+        hoisted rows must cut it field by field."""
+        q_lora = Mxfp8Activation(
+            q=torch.arange(320).view(5, 64), scale=torch.arange(10).view(5, 2)
+        )
+        positions = torch.tensor([2, 3, 3, 0, 0])
+        self._run(torch.tensor([7, 7, 9]), torch.tensor([2, 3, 3]), positions, q_lora)
+        self.assertTrue(torch.equal(self.index_q_lora.q, q_lora.q[:3]))
+        self.assertTrue(torch.equal(self.index_q_lora.scale, q_lora.scale[:3]))
+

     unittest.main()
